description: COMEX gold futures trading day. One row per day.
Calendar year of date.
Calendar month of date.
Weekday name of date.
Gold futures (GC=F, front month) opening price. Empty on days where Yahoo kept only a closing price (mostly before 2008).
Gold futures daily high. Raised to at least max(open, close) where the raw bar was inconsistent.
Gold futures daily low. Lowered to at most min(open, close) where the raw bar was inconsistent.
Gold futures daily close. This is the main target column.
Gold futures volume for the front-month contract. Empty where Yahoo reports zero.
Silver futures (SI=F) close.
Platinum futures (PL=F) close.
Palladium futures (PA=F) close.
Copper futures (HG=F) close.
Brent crude futures (BZ=F) close. Starts 2007-07-30.
WTI crude futures (CL=F) close. Negative on 2020-04-20 (real market event).
US Dollar Index (DX-Y.NYB) close.
US dollar to Chinese yuan rate. Starts 2001-06-25.
US dollar to Indian rupee rate. Starts 2003-12-01.
S&P 500 index close.
CBOE VIX volatility index close.
Bitcoin price (BTC-USD) on the same date. Starts 2014-09-17.
SPDR Gold Shares ETF (GLD) close, not adjusted. Starts 2004-11-18.
VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) close, not adjusted. Starts 2006-05-22.
GLD trading volume, a rough proxy for investor flows into gold.
2-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield (DGS2).
10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield (DGS10).
10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10), the classic opportunity cost of holding gold. Starts 2003-01-02.
10-year breakeven inflation rate (T10YIE). Starts 2003-01-02.
5-year, 5-year forward inflation expectation (T5YIFR). Starts 2003-01-02.
Effective federal funds rate (DFF).
Daily US Economic Policy Uncertainty index, Baker, Bloom and Davis (USEPUINDXD). Noisy day to day; smooth before use.
Lower bound of the Fed funds target range (DFEDTARL). Before 2008-12-16 the single target (DFEDTAR).
Upper bound of the Fed funds target range (DFEDTARU). Before 2008-12-16 the single target (DFEDTAR).
Daily Geopolitical Risk index, based on the share of newspaper articles about geopolitical tensions.
GPR sub-index for geopolitical acts (wars, attacks that happened).
GPR sub-index for geopolitical threats (war threats, tensions).
Daily percent change of gold_close.
Daily log return of gold_close.
20-day rolling standard deviation of gold_log_return times sqrt(252).
50-day simple moving average of gold_close.
200-day simple moving average of gold_close.
Highest gold_close up to and including this day (from 2000-08-30).
Percent below gold_all_time_high. 0 on record days.
1 if gold_close set a new all-time high for this file.
Ounces of silver one ounce of gold buys (gold_close / silver_close).
Barrels of Brent one ounce of gold buys (gold_close / brent_close).
Gold price in Indian rupees (gold_close x usd_inr).
Gold price in Chinese yuan (gold_close x usd_cny).
Name of the major event(s) whose first market reaction falls on this day; several events are joined with ' | '.
Category of each event in event_name: geopolitical, monetary_policy, financial_crisis, trade_currency, pandemic or market.
1 if at least one event from gold_events_timeline.csv reacts on this day.
Calendar date the event happened or was announced.
First gold trading day whose close can reflect the event: the same day, or the next trading day if the event was on a weekend, a holiday or after the US close.
Short event name.
geopolitical, monetary_policy, financial_crisis, trade_currency, pandemic or market.
Main region involved.
One-sentence factual description.
1 if the news broke after the US gold settlement, so the reaction is on the next trading day.
Gold close on the trading day before reaction_date.
Gold change from gold_close_before to the close on reaction_date.
Gold change from gold_close_before to the close 5 trading days later (counting reaction_date as day 1).
Gold change from gold_close_before to the close 20 trading days later. Empty if 20 days have not passed yet.
Reference for the event.
Date the new Fed target took effect in FRED. Since 2008 this is usually the day after the FOMC announcement; before that it is usually the announcement day.
New lower bound of the target range (single target before 2008-12-16).
New upper bound of the target range (single target before 2008-12-16).
Size of the change; positive is a hike, negative a cut.
hike or cut.
Gold change from the close before effective_date to 20 trading days later. Empty before gold data starts or if 20 days have not passed.
Calendar month.
Average gold_close over the month.
Last gold_close of the month.
Average silver_close over the month.
Average brent_close over the month.
Average dxy_close over the month.
Average 10-year TIPS real yield over the month.
Average effective Fed funds rate over the month.
Average daily GPR index over all calendar days of the month.
Average daily US Economic Policy Uncertainty index over the month.
US CPI for all urban consumers, seasonally adjusted (CPIAUCSL). Values are for the reference month, not the release date.
US M2 money stock, seasonally adjusted (M2SL).
US unemployment rate (UNRATE).
Year-on-year change of cpi_index.
Year-on-year change of m2_money_supply_bn.
gold_avg deflated by cpi_index into dollars of the latest CPI month in the file.
Percent change of gold_close from the previous month.
